name: Detection of Anemia Using Colour of the Fingernails Image Dataset
description: A non-invasive clinical research dataset of 710 fingernail images paired with hemoglobin level measurements and anemia status, collected in Ghana to investigate machine learning algorithms for preliminary anemia screening. Safeguard notice: This dataset is intended exclusively for academic algorithmic exploration and preliminary screening research; it is not a clinically validated diagnostic device or medical test.
